title: At the Iron Gate  (Al cancello di ferro)

segments.t: Fuori, sotto i rami dell'albero alla Locanda del Cortile del Tiglio, a Portland, il fratello maggiore Owen resta dritto nel suo cappotto grigio davanti a Caleb, mentre Hannah posa una teiera calda e fa un passo indietro. Ascolta prima tutta la scena.
So 'someone with something from Grandfather' was you all along, Caleb.
Hello, Owen. Thank you for coming today.
I recognized your neat block handwriting on that postcard in two seconds.
Wait, you knew it was from me and came anyway?
Of course I came. Why did you hide behind a mystery note?
Because I was afraid you were still angry. I missed you these three years.
Three stubborn years... honestly, little brother, I missed you too.
Excuse me, gentlemen. Here is hot tea, and warm lemon cake is on the way.
Lemon cake? Wait, how did she know about Friday lemon cake?
Sit down, Owen, take off your heavy coat, and look at this blue suitcase.
Is that the old dark blue bag from Grandfather's workshop?
Take all the time you need. The courtyard is yours.
Ora rivediamo la conversazione con calma, frase per frase.
So 'someone with something from Grandfather' was you all along, Caleb.
'Quindi «qualcuno con qualcosa del nonno» eri tu fin dall'inizio, Caleb.'
Hello, Owen. Thank you for coming today.
'Ciao, Owen. Grazie per essere venuto oggi.'
I recognized your neat block handwriting on that postcard in two seconds.
'Ho riconosciuto la tua calligrafia ordinata in stampatello su quella cartolina in due secondi.'
Wait, you knew it was from me and came anyway?
'Aspetta, sapevi che veniva da parte mia e sei venuto lo stesso?'
Of course I came. Why did you hide behind a mystery note?
'Certo che sono venuto. Perché ti sei nascosto dietro un biglietto misterioso?'
Because I was afraid you were still angry. I missed you these three years.
'Perché avevo paura che fossi ancora arrabbiato. Mi sei mancato in questi tre anni.'
Three stubborn years... honestly, little brother, I missed you too.
'Tre anni testardi... sinceramente, fratellino, sei mancato anche tu a me.'
Excuse me, gentlemen. Here is hot tea, and warm lemon cake is on the way.
'Scusatemi, signori. Ecco il tè caldo, e la torta tiepida al limone è in arrivo.'
Lemon cake? Wait, how did she know about Friday lemon cake?
'Torta al limone? Aspetta, come faceva a sapere della torta al limone del venerdì?'
Sit down, Owen, take off your heavy coat, and look at this blue suitcase.
'Siediti, Owen, togliti il cappotto pesante e guarda questa valigia blu.'
Is that the old dark blue bag from Grandfather's workshop?
'È la vecchia borsa blu scuro del laboratorio del nonno?'
Take all the time you need. The courtyard is yours.
'Prendetevi tutto il tempo che vi serve. Il cortile è vostro.'
Ascoltiamo di nuovo tutta la scena a velocità naturale.
So 'someone with something from Grandfather' was you all along, Caleb.
Hello, Owen. Thank you for coming today.
I recognized your neat block handwriting on that postcard in two seconds.
Wait, you knew it was from me and came anyway?
Of course I came. Why did you hide behind a mystery note?
Because I was afraid you were still angry. I missed you these three years.
Three stubborn years... honestly, little brother, I missed you too.
Excuse me, gentlemen. Here is hot tea, and warm lemon cake is on the way.
Lemon cake? Wait, how did she know about Friday lemon cake?
Sit down, Owen, take off your heavy coat, and look at this blue suitcase.
Is that the old dark blue bag from Grandfather's workshop?
Take all the time you need. The courtyard is yours.
Owen ha riconosciuto la grafia di Caleb in due secondi ed è venuto lo stesso. Nella prossima scena aprono il pacchetto di carta bianca sotto l'albero del cortile. Alla prossima.
See you soon!
